summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for bank reconciliation and trial-balance requirements on public URL; targeted regression and smoke suites passed.
action_items: No blocking bugs found in scoped reconciliation/trial-balance formulas and UI signs.
Optional refactor: split backend/server.py into smaller modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is very large (>700 lines), which increases maintenance and change-risk across accounting flows.
Auth lockout is configured and verified at 3 failed attempts / 3 minutes (matches project auth docs).
Reconciliation save path correctly uses breakdown.reconciliation_balance and does not re-apply checks into calculated_balance.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed reconciliation memo from UI and TEST-prefixed API records inside pytest. Pytest cleanup fixtures remove created reconciliation/deposit/revenue/expense/journal artifacts by prefix where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated requested reconciliation two-stage formula and trial-balance classification behavior through existing targeted suites (9/9 pass), added smoke endpoints suite (6/6 pass), auth playbook checks (4/4 pass), and reconciliation save integrity test (1/1 pass). UI Playwright verified reconciliation breakdown cards, print sign labels (outstanding=added, collection=deducted), memo save flow, and trial-balance row 1250 hidden in normal view. ETA Electronic Invoice integration is MOCKED and out of scope.
rca of the issue: No open issue found in scoped features during this run.
